# Toolkit Lab

> Toolkit Lab is a free website with 58 browser-based tools for PDFs, images, video audio, calculators and text, plus practical guides. Files are processed on the user's device and are not uploaded.

## Categories
- [PDF tools](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/pdf-tools)
- [Image tools](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/image-tools)
- [Calculators](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/calculators)
- [Text and developer tools](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/text-and-developer-tools)

## Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/merge-pdf): combine PDF files in any order
- [Split PDF](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/split-pdf): extract selected pages from a PDF
- [Rotate PDF](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/rotate-pdf): rotate all pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees
- [JPG and PNG to PDF](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-to-pdf): one image per PDF page
- [PDF to JPG](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/pdf-to-jpg): save each PDF page as a JPG
- [Image Compressor](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-compressor): shrink JPEG, PNG and WebP files
- [Image Resizer](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-resizer): resize images and aim for a target file size
- [Image Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-converter): convert between JPG, PNG and WebP
- [PSD to PNG / JPG](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/psd-converter): convert Photoshop files
- [Video to MP3](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/video-to-mp3): extract audio from a video file on your device
- [Loan Payment Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/loan-calculator): monthly payment and total interest
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/bmi-calculator): body mass index
- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/percentage-calculator)
- [Date Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/date-calculator): days between dates
- [Age Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/age-calculator): exact age in years, months and days
- [Unit Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/unit-converter): length, weight and temperature
- [Word Counter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/word-counter)
- [Case Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/case-converter)
- [Data File Formatter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/json-formatter)
- [Text to Code Converter (Base64)](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/base64)
- [Placeholder Text Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator)
- [File Fingerprint Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/hash-generator): SHA-256, SHA-512 and more
- [Password Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/password-generator)
- [QR Code Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/qr-code-generator)
- [Colour Code Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/color-converter): HEX, RGB and HSL
- [Text Diff Checker](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/text-diff-checker): compare two texts line by line
- [Discount Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/discount-calculator): sale price, savings and tax
- [Tip Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/tip-calculator): tip, total and split between people
- [Random Number Generator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/random-number-generator): random numbers in a range
- [Web Address Text Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/url-encoder): percent-encode and decode text
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/compound-interest-calculator): savings growth over time
- [Monthly Investment Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/sip-calculator): monthly investment growth
- [Sales Tax and VAT Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/sales-tax-vat-calculator): add or remove sales tax or VAT
- [Computer Date Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/unix-timestamp-converter): epoch time and dates
- [Web Page Name Maker](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/url-slug-generator): clean URL slugs from titles
- [Roman Numeral Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/roman-numeral-converter)
- [Text Pattern Tester](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/regex-tester): test regular expressions
- [Typing Speed Test](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/typing-speed-test): words per minute and accuracy
- [Image to Code Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/image-to-base64): data URI for small images
- [Spreadsheet to Data File Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/csv-to-json): turn CSV into JSON
- [Simple Text Formatting Preview](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/markdown-preview): see Markdown formatted
- [Password Strength Checker](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/password-strength-checker): estimate password strength on your device
- [Fraction Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/fraction-calculator): add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions
- [Speed, Distance and Time Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/speed-distance-time-calculator)
- [Salary to Hourly Pay Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/salary-to-hourly-converter)
- [Time Duration Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/time-duration-calculator): hours between two times
- [Number System Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/number-base-converter): binary, decimal, hex and octal
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/simple-interest-calculator)
- [Running Pace Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/running-pace-calculator)
- [Remove Duplicate Lines](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/remove-duplicate-lines)
- [Dice Roller](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/dice-roller)
- [Mean, Median and Mode Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/mean-median-mode-calculator)
- [Fuel Economy Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/fuel-economy-converter): mpg and litres per 100 km
- [Text to Speech](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/text-to-speech): read pasted text aloud in the browser
- [File Size Converter](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/data-size-converter): bits, bytes, KB, MB and GB
- [Download Time Calculator](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/download-time-calculator): estimate download time
- [Text Readability Checker](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/color-contrast-checker): WCAG contrast ratios
- [Online Stopwatch](https://www.toolkitlab.xyz/tools/stopwatch)
